# In pandas 3.0.0, skipna parameter behavior on argmax is stricter
s = pd.Series([1.0, np.nan, 3.0])
result = s.argmax()

before_snippet:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# In pandas 2.3.3, Series.argmax(skipna=False) with NaN returns index position
s = pd.Series([1.0, np.nan, 3.0])
result = s.argmax(skipna=False)
assert result == -1 or isinstance(result, (int, np.integer)), "Should return -1 or compatible with deprecated behavior"
title: Removal of deprecated Series.argmax/argmin with skipna parameter behavior
